entities.name: Security Mode Command Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to establish security between the network and UE in RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where the UE has an established RRC connection with the network.

entities.name: Signalling Radio Bearer 1
entities.description: First signalling radio bearer used for RRC and NAS message transfer.

entities.name: Signalling Radio Bearer 2
entities.description: Second signalling radio bearer used for NAS message transfer.

entities.name: Data Radio Bearer
entities.description: Radio bearer used for user data transfer.

entities.name: Multicast Radio Bearer
entities.description: Radio bearer used for multicast data transfer.

entities.name: Only SRB1 established condition
entities.description: Condition where SRB1 is established but SRB2, multicast MRBs and/or DRBs are not yet established.

relations.description: Security mode command procedure requires the UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Security mode command procedure is applied when only SRB1 is established.
Condition where only SRB1 is established prior to establishment of SRB2, multicast MRBs and/or DRBs.
